name: Sakuranomori Misaki
source:
Likes: Sakura, bathing
Dislikes: People who are intolerant to others
Hobbies: Shopping, tampering with musical instruments, Ohanami (cherry blossom viewing)

Kenji catches her falling out of a tree and accidentally touches her breast which she considers more intimate than a kiss and therefore, according to her family's tradition, she must marry him. Her pride makes the other girls her rivals for Kenji despite not really liking him.
